initialization: New seeded random network and empty replay buffer; no imported weights, optimizer or trajectories.
selection: The first accepted successor to 20 was 26, selected for the first independent arena. Following the user request, train from 26 to its next internally promoted successor M and compare only that accepted checkpoint on the second independent seed. If still needed, run ten more attempts and compare latest on the third seed. Retain every observation.

confirmation.multiple_look_correction: Bonferroni over the three prespecified independent arenas; no reseeding of failed tests.
confirmation.attempt_boundary_rule: First arena at 26. Resolve M as the first internally promoted successor of 26; subsequent boundaries are M and M+10, stopping when confirmation succeeds.
confirmation.seed_ranges: Each arena uses 400 pair seeds [base, base+399]; successive bases differ by 1000, so holdout seed ranges do not overlap.

publication: Keep config/training.toml and its champion unchanged until the new lineage passes independent confirmation and required checks.
performance: Measure old and cleaned source on the same M4 Max, fixed workloads and checkpoint; interleave runs without concurrent training. Training wall times are observations, not speedup estimates.
limits: One training seed cannot prove unchanged learning efficiency across seeds.
Finite strength arenas and benchmarks cannot prove absence of every regression.
